title: CWP/8248/2025 of GURJINDER SINGH Vs STATE OF PUNJAB AND OTHERS
judge: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE HARSIMRAN SINGH SETHI
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH (102) CWP-8248-2025 Date of Decision : March 25, 2025 Gurjinder Singh .. Petitioner Versus State of Punjab and others .. Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE HARSIMRAN SINGH SETHI Present: Mr. G.P.S. Bal, Advocate, for the petitioner. Ms. Akshita Chauhan, DAG, Punjab. HARSIMRAN SINGH SETHI J. (ORAL)

1. In the present writ petition, the only grievance of the petitioner is that the State Information Commissioner, Punjab is not deciding the appeal dated 17.07.2024 (Annexure P-5) preferred by the petitioner and the delay is causing prejudice to him.

2. Notice of motion.

3. Ms. Akshita Chauhan, learned Deputy Advocate General, Punjab, who is present in the Court, accepts notice on behalf of the respondents.

4. Learned counsel for the respondents submits that the appeal of the petitioner dated 17.07.2024 (Annexure P-5) will be decided as expeditiously as possible.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that keeping in view the statement of learned counsel for the respondents, no further grievance of the petitioner survives in the present writ petition and the same may kindly be disposed of having been not pressed any further.

6. Ordered accordingly. March 25, 2025 (HARSIMRAN SINGH SETHI) harsha JUDGE
